why: Today's tooling, lead tooling fast-tracked, one agent in a cloud box. Decision 0178 at review time: the field check (.github/ci/field-check.ts) now refuses an added merge-ready review row (step or role review, outcome done or pass) when the pull request adds or changes an .integration. law and the row has no `green` key citing where those laws ran green: {"_tag": "ci", "run": <full run id>} or {"_tag": "box", "command": <text>, "head": <full commit>}. The field check is where the review's row and the pull request's changed paths meet, on every pull request and in pnpm lint, with no network; land.ts arm reads the full run itself at the merge. Seven new laws in .github/ci/field-check.green.test.ts, and `green` added to the old test's contract schema. Ten plants, each run once on field-check.ts or field-schema.ts and restored, all red.
note: pnpm lint's lint:dead ran out of memory at node's default heap in this box (code-graph, about 2 GB); with NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 it passed with no new finding. drive.ts writes no `green`, so the lead adds it to a drive review's row before saving it.
